title: Rust
philosophy: The compiler as the strictest, fairest teacher you'll ever have — it slows you down early, explains exactly why, and in return hands you speed and safety no scripting language can promise.

units.title: Rust Fast Foundations
units.summary: Compressed basics; assumes any prior track's Foundations but stands alone.
topics: cargo and rustc: your first build
control flow: if, loop, while, for
println! and the macros you use before you write any

units.title: Ownership and Borrowing
units.summary: THE unit — the idea every other Rust feature depends on, taken slowly.
topics: stack, heap, and why Rust cares
functions, arguments, and giving values away
mutable references and the aliasing rule
ownership drills: fix the broken code

units.title: Structs, Enums, Pattern Matching
units.summary: Modeling data the Rust way: structs, enums that carry data, and exhaustive matching.

units.title: Collections, Strings, Slices
units.summary: Vec, String, HashMap — and the ownership questions they force; ends with the Core capstone.
topics: indexing, iteration, and borrow rules in loops
String and &str for real this time
UTF-8 and why strings can't be indexed
the entry API and counting patterns

units.title: Error Handling
units.summary: Result, Option, and ? — errors the type system won't let you ignore.
topics: Result<T, E> and matching on it
unwrap, expect, and when they're fine
custom error types and From conversions
error-handling drills across a small program

units.title: Traits and Generics
units.summary: Shared behavior and code that works for many types — Rust's answer to interfaces.
topics: the Iterator trait and adapter chains

units.title: Modules, Cargo, Testing
units.summary: Real project structure: modules, crates, dependencies, and tests; ends with the Intermediate capstone.
topics: capstone: library crate with a CLI front-end

units.title: Smart Pointers and Lifetimes
units.summary: Under the hood: Box, Rc, RefCell, and the lifetime annotations the compiler was writing for you.
topics: lifetimes: what the compiler was inferring all along
a taste of Arc and Mutex for threads

units.title: Capstone: Real CLI Tool
units.summary: Multi-session capstone: a real command-line tool, built the Rust way.
topics: file I/O and error handling end to end
polish: clippy-clean and a performance pass
ship it: release builds and distribution
